name: concurrency_probe_rt
description: Reentrant twin of concurrency_probe. Declares reentrant:true, so the host calls its process() concurrently under a parallel dispatch pool -> max concurrency climbs above 1.

outputs.name: maxc
outputs.doc: Max workers seen inside process() at once.

outputs.name: overlaps
outputs.doc: Count of process() entries that found another already inside.
